newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait Central Bank assets fall slightly.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait Central Bank assets fall slightly.

text.p: Kuwait Central Bank's total assets and liabilities fell to 1.118 billion dinars ($3.739 billion) at the end of December 1996 from 1.197 billion at the end of November.

The Central Bank's balance sheet published in Monday's official gazette also showed a fall in domestic bonds in Kuwaiti dinars and public debt instruments to 43.9 million dinars at the end of 1996 from 122.9 million on November 30, 1996.

Liquid assets, accounts, bonds, certificates of deposit, treasury bills and deposits in foreign currency were worth 1.021 billion dinars at the end of December, compared with 1.026 billion at the end of November.

Currency in circulation rose to 411.54 million dinars from 389.38 million at the end of November. Accounts by domestic banks in the Central Bank also rose during the same period to 63.24 million dinars from 47.37 million.
